source_basis.predecessor_source_reuse: Pure computational continuation of the role-local certified exact-curtailment/batch model; no new external empirical claim introduced.

tested_model.terminal_rule: commit iff W_r>=k with exact deterministic curtailment
tested_model.wall_round_cost: For each reached candidate stage, launch b paired observations per synchronous batch and pay ceil(N_stage/b) rounds; false commit terminates the stream.
tested_model.objective: directly search for action multisets/orderings whose exact all-null q95 wall rounds improve on the pair-count-derived wall frontier at equal-or-higher worst-position q=.60 true-commit power.

mathematical_transfer.result: The predecessor's action-level conditional-survival FOSD pruning remains valid after deterministic batching.
mathematical_transfer.reason: If X is first-order stochastically no larger than Y, then ceil(X/b) is first-order stochastically no larger than ceil(Y/b) for every positive integer b because ceil(.) is monotone. Independent convolution preserves FOSD. Therefore any earlier multiset dominance argument that relied only on componentwise matching of the certified conditional-survival action order remains sound in wall-round space.
mathematical_transfer.scope: This does not by itself prove that every pair-q95-suboptimal but FOSD-incomparable multiset is wall-q95-suboptimal; exact wall reoptimization is still needed for a global certificate.

enumeration_and_screen.power_order: For each multiset, exchange-sort by increasing p1/(1-p0), which retains the predecessor's exact maximin-power lemma.
enumeration_and_screen.screen_construction: For every one of the 79 power levels and each batch size, retain the 20 lowest vectors under each of two independent wall-cost surrogates: (a) conditional-survival mean plus 1.64485 standard deviations, and (b) exact exchange-order expected all-null wall rounds. Take the union, yielding 492-496 unique multisets per batch size. This deliberately includes vectors not on the pair-count Pareto map.
enumeration_and_screen.exact_evaluation: For every retained multiset, compute the exact null curtailed reject/survive discordant-count law, mix each stopped discordant count through NegativeBinomial(d,.20), transform stage pair counts to ceil(N/b), and convolve the full reject/survive stream to obtain exact q95 wall rounds.
enumeration_and_screen.adjacent_reordering_search: For every exact screened Pareto point, starting from the exchange order, test all adjacent swaps that preserve the original worst-position power and greedily iterate any exact q95 wall-round improvement. No improving swap was found at b=4,8,16,32.

results.within_predecessor_certified_power_range: The exact screened wall frontier reproduces the predecessor's pair-derived wall frontier: b4/b8 retain all pair-power breakpoints, while b16/b32 lose points only through the previously observed equal-round ties. No pair-count-suboptimal screened multiset dominates a current equal-or-lower-power wall point.
results.outside_previous_pair_budget_domain: Two higher-power admissible multisets, not part of the earlier 1800-3300 pair-budget certificate, appear at worst-position powers 0.053395984646347566 and 0.053465547907689266. Their exchange-order q95 wall rounds are respectively 852/431/approximately-220/approximately-115 and 855/432/221/116 for b=4/8/16/32. These extend the wall frontier only if the wall-round budget rather than the old pair-count cap is authoritative.

interpretation: The direct wall objective did not uncover a hidden large multiset-level gain in a broad exact candidate screen. This materially narrows the concern raised by the predecessor checkpoint that batching might make a pair-count-suboptimal multiset preferable.
The observed wall-clock changes are currently dominated by quantization/ties and occupancy inflation, not by a different action-family composition, in the screened region.
The FOSD-transfer lemma explains part of this robustness: batching cannot reverse any predecessor dominance relation that was already full-distributional rather than q95-only.
rejected_or_narrowed_generalizations: Rejected in the exact screen: coarse batching necessarily reveals a materially better pair-count-suboptimal action multiset. None did across 492-496 exact candidates per batch size and all 79 power levels represented by two independent cost screens.
Rejected in the tested local ordering neighborhood: exchange-maximin ordering necessarily leaves wall-q95 savings available through power-preserving adjacent swaps. None were found.

Narrowed: this is not yet a mathematical global certificate over all 246729 multisets and all power-feasible orderings in wall-round space. The candidate screen is broad but surrogate-based, and the reordering search is local.
Narrowed: no claim yet for variable latency, stragglers, asynchronous refill/cancel, cross-candidate concurrency, or intermediate discordant depths outside {10,20,30,50}.

frontier.action: Turn the broad screen into a global wall-round certificate by adapting the predecessor's optimistic conditional-survival q95 necessary bound directly to stagewise ceil(N/b) costs, Pareto-prune all 246729 vectors, and run exact power-constrained ordering DP only on the surviving razor sets.
Jointly optimize wall rounds and paid-pair occupancy rather than wall rounds alone; quantify how much occupancy must be paid for each additional q95-round reduction at b=4,8,16,32.
Add variable paired rollout latency and stragglers. Compare synchronous batches, asynchronous refill, and cancellable in-flight pairs while preserving candidate freeze/selection validity.
Broaden discordant depths beyond {10,20,30,50} only after the current finite action class is globally certified in wall space.

frontier.exact_next_action: Implement the exact order-independent wall-round necessary bound for every admissible multiset: convolve conditional-survival stage-round distributions at b=4,8,16,32, combine with no-false-commit survival using the optimistic zero-cost false-commit bound, and use it to certify whether any of the unscreened vectors can beat the current exact wall frontier before invoking ordering DP.
